dataset.note: gen_id_2k harvests every qualifying (s,t) pair of each sampled graph and splits train/val per example, not per graph: val asks new queries on training graphs, so accuracy mixes reachability with per-graph memorisation. Compare arm accuracy to the query-blind baseline, not to 0.5.

query_blind_baseline.rule: predict the majority train label of the input graph; ignores s, t

eval_protocol: runner val loop: batches of 1 padded to the checkpoint's max_len; truncation reproduced (on_overflow='allow') and reported

covariate_matched_ood.note: rows with unseen tokens feed untrained embeddings to every arm; label-dependent graph sizes let the size token separate classes. Results on this set mix hop length with vocabulary and size shift.

ood_hops.note: rows with unseen tokens feed untrained embeddings to every arm; label-dependent graph sizes let the size token separate classes. Results on this set mix hop length with vocabulary and size shift.

metric_definitions.acc_answerable: accuracy excluding rows whose encoding exceeds max_len
metric_definitions.perturb_gain_by_t: ||Δz_t||_F / ||Δz_0||_F over real tokens for eps_sigma·N(0,1) added to c = tok_emb + pos_emb
metric_definitions.perturb_gain_rel_by_t: same with each ||Δz_t|| divided by ||z_t|| (removes state-norm growth)
metric_definitions.pooled_ratio_by_t: ||mean_i z_t,i|| / mean_i ||z_t,i|| (1 iff all tokens parallel)
metric_definitions.token_cos_by_t: mean pairwise cosine between distinct real tokens of z_t (FF: residual stream after embeddings / each block)

other_affected_artifacts.note: param_count = non-embedding + (vocab + max_len)·d implies max_len = 64: the 64-token floor of the same first-rows rule, shorter than most n≥12 encodings, so most rows lost their QUERY tokens (consistent with 0.0 acc on every positive hop bucket)
